feedback:
Decision: approve. This candidate is valid and well supported by earlier races. We are in early exploration with 7 iterations left, so racing it gives the most useful telemetry, and the best raced score so far is 53.94 (iteration 3).

Why the changes are sound: (1) sensor_size 0.012 to 0.016 targets the oval. Iterations 0 to 3 all show oval max_error at 0.0607 to 0.0614, just over the 0.06 m off-track limit, with progress stuck at 0.115 to 0.124. Iteration 2 showed the wider +/-0.05 m array removed oval line-loss events, but did not lift progress, so the footprint is the next untested sensing lever. (2) line_loss last_direction to search_right addresses s-bend and slalom. Last_direction gave exactly one line-loss event per run on those tracks in iterations 0 to 3 (s-bend 0.1575 progress, slalom 0.1075). search_right is untested. (3) base_speed 1.4 and kd 0.30 are kept from iteration 3, the best raced design.

Weakness: two groups change at once (footprint and recovery direction). The footprint should mainly affect the oval and the recovery direction mainly affects s-bend and slalom, so the telemetry per track should still separate the two.

How to read the race: (a) If oval max_error falls below 0.06 with 0 line losses, keep sensor_size 0.016. (b) If s-bend or slalom line-loss events drop to 0, or progress rises above 0.1575 and 0.1075, keep search_right. (c) If s-bend or slalom line-loss events rise, the search direction was wrong: next revision should use search_left with the same geometry. (d) If the oval still shows max_error at or above 0.06 with sensor_size 0.016, try base_speed 1.2 before changing kp, since slower entry into the first corner is the remaining lever. (e) If steering_oscillation rises well above 0.15, lower kd to about 0.20 rather than cutting kp.
requested_changes: If the oval max_error stays at or above 0.06 with sensor_size 0.016, set base_speed to about 1.2 with all other fields fixed. Evidence: oval progress has been 0.115 to 0.124 at speeds 1.4 and 1.6, and max_error has stayed at 0.0607 to 0.0614 throughout.

If s-bend or slalom line_loss_events stays at 1 with controller.line_loss search_right, switch to search_left with the same geometry. Evidence: last_direction gave one line-loss event per run on s-bend and slalom in iterations 0 to 3.
If steering_oscillation rises well above 0.15, reduce kd from 0.30 to about 0.20 and keep kp at 4.0. Evidence: iteration 1 (kd 0.30) gave oscillation of 0.154 on s-bend and 0.158 on slalom.
